info.name: Contour List HTTPProxy resources in a namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned resources by their labels. Defaults to everything.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned resources by their fields.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of responses to return per page. If there are additional results, a continue token is returned.

params.name: continue
params.description: A continuation token for paginating through large result sets, returned from a previous list call.

items.docs: Returns a list of all HTTPProxy custom resources in the specified Kubernetes namespace. Results can be filtered using label selectors and field selectors.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

items.docs: Creates a new HTTPProxy custom resource in the specified namespace. The HTTPProxy defines virtual hosts, routing rules, TLS configuration, and load balancing behavior for inbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic.

items.docs: Replaces the entire HTTPProxy resource with the provided specification. The resourceVersion in the metadata must match the current version to prevent conflicting updates.

params.name: namespace

info.name: Contour List HTTPProxy resources across all namespaces

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned resources by their labels. Defaults to everything.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: A selector to restrict the list of returned resources by their fields.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of responses to return per page. If there are additional results, a continue token is returned.

params.name: continue
params.description: A continuation token for paginating through large result sets, returned from a previous list call.

items.docs: Returns all HTTPProxy custom resources across all namespaces in the cluster. Useful for cluster-wide visibility into all ingress configurations managed by Contour.
